[[File:Matthew Ford 2026 US Nationals.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Matthew Ford at the [[2026 U.S. National Championship]].]]
'''Matthew Ford''' (GEMP handle '''WormTime''')<ref name="retro-gempc-86781">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC], forum.starwarsccg.org (14 June 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/Player_List_for_2026_Retro_GEMPC_forum_t86781 Internet Archive]. [[:File:SWCCG forum t86781 Player List for 2026 Retro GEMPC.txt]]</ref> finished 2nd at the [[2026 Retro U.S. Nationals]].<ref name="pc-rusn26" /> He also won [[2025 Retro League Event 3|Event 3 of the 2025 Retro League]]<ref name="p1439242" /> and finished 14th at the [[2026 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)]].<ref name="pc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026/ 2026-09 Retro GEMP Match Play Championship (Premiere to DSII)], starwarsccg.org (published 10 September 2026). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/2026_Retro_GEMPC_starwarsccg_org/2026-09-retro-gemp-match-play-championship-premiere-to-dsii-july-to-sept-2026.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> He streams Star Wars CCG on [https://www.twitch.tv/w0rmt1m3 twitch.tv/w0rmt1m3].<ref name="tw-w0rm" />
